description_zh: 调用CreateUploadFileJob接口，创建上传附件任务
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise create-upload-file-job --file-source datacorrect --file-name test.txt --upload-url https://XXX.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/test.txt --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUploadFileJob

parameters.help_en:
The purpose of the uploaded attachment. Valid values:
datacorrect: Data change ticket.
order_info_attachment: Ticket attachment.
big-file: Batch data import.
sqlreview: SQL review
parameters.help_zh:
上传附件的使用目的，取值说明如下：
datacorrect：数据变更工单。
order_info_attachment：工单附件。
big-file：批量数据导入。
sqlreview：SQL审核
parameters.name: file_source

parameters.help_en:
The file name.
The file name must end with .txt or .sql, such as test.txt or test.sql
parameters.help_zh:
文件名称。
文件名称需要以txt、sql结尾。例如test.txt、test.sql
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the uploaded attachment. Only HTTP and HTTPS URLs are supported.
You can upload an object to a bucket and obtain the shared URL of the object. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195674.html
parameters.help_zh:
上传附件URL链接，此处链接仅支持HTTP和HTTPS链接。
您可以将文件（Object）上传至存储空间（Bucket）后，获取文件的分享URL，更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/195674.html
parameters.name: upload_url

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: tid

ErrorMessage.example: Unsupported url scheme : null, scheme must be https or http

JobKey.description_en:
The key of the file upload task.
You can call the [GetUserUploadFileJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html） operation to query the progress and details of the file upload task
JobKey.description_zh:
上传附件任务值。
您可以通过调用[GetUserUploadFileJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206069.html）接口查询附件上传的进展与任务详情

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值说明如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
